rca of the issue: P0 #1 (category filter broken): list_products_enhanced was setting `query['$or'] = []` when either category or brand was empty, then later overwriting `query['$or']` with actual criteria. This wiped the search $or block AND when only one of category/brand was set, the empty $or:[] evaluated to no-match in MongoDB → 0 results. Fix uses `$and` list with per-filter `$or` sub-clauses, preserving the top-level search `$or`. Verified: Tavalar=72, Öztiryakiler=1596, Tavalar+search=67 all match expected. P0 #2 (auto-pricing not working): four call sites were doing string-regex on `category_path` to find products for a rule. Since İkas categories are stored as an `ikas_categories: [{name, ...}]` array, the regex missed products that only had the name in the array. Fix queries `ikas_categories.name` first with category_path as fallback. Verified: POST /api/competitor/scan-all returns `{started:true, total:31}` and progress reaches 1/31 in the UI.
